intermediate.title: Sprint | 1st passage of the finish line (202.4 km)

story: Stage 1 of Lidl Deutschland Tour 2026 saw an early breakaway of three riders. Numerous attacks ensued in the finale, with Kelderman and Hébert gaining a 45-second lead before being caught 6 km from the finish. At 4 km, Louis Barré attacked, followed only by Paul Magnier. Magnier dropped back on the final climb, allowing Barré to secure a solo victory and take the overall lead.
